General.Where and when is Aether happening?: The event will be happening on Friday, September 25th, 12:00 to 4:00 pm! IT will be happening on 8th floor of DICE at the University of Alberta North Campus.
General.What will the in-person fair be like?: The in-person portion will be split into 2 parts. The first half is more like a job fair where students will be able to network with companies and learn about oppurtunities in the industry. The second half will be more for having a fun time where students will get the opprutunity to partcipate in competitions to get prizes!
General.Will there be food at the in-person even: There will only be food served for company representatives and volunteers.
General.Who is the intended audience for this ev: This fair is meant for students interested in the tech field and companies hiring for tech roles like Software Developer, Data Scientist, ML Engineer and more - not restricted to Engineering or CS students or 'purely' tech companies.

Companies/Orgs.How do I register and by when?: You can register by reaching out to us at external@compeclub.com. The deadline is September 22nd but the early pricing deadline is July 20th.
Companies/Orgs.What is the Cancellation Policy?: Grace Period: full refund will be granted if written notification of cancellation is received via email within 48-hours of registration. Cancellations received after 5:00 PM (MT) on September 30th 2024 are ineligible for grace period. Cancellations made outside of the 48-hour grace period but before 5:00 PM (MDT) on September 30th, 2024 will be charged a $100 cancellation fee to cover administration and processing costs. Cancellations made after 5:00 PM (MT) on September 30th, 2024 will be charged the full fee.
Companies/Orgs.How early should I show up to set up my: Please plan to be there 30 min before your scheduled section at the latest. If you are only attending the career-fair portion this would be 2:30pm MDT. You can also ship any marketing/promotional material in advance. Please let us know by September 30th if you need this.
Companies/Orgs.For when are students looking for a posi: Most students will be looking for a Winter/Summer 2025 position (given when this event takes place) starting in January or May. However some students may also be seeking a new grad position starting around May or September.
Companies/Orgs.How many students can we expect to speak: Last year (our first Aether event), we had around 1200 participants, primarily Computer Science and Engineering students with a few visitors from NAIT and MacEwan! We expect similar numbers this year.
Companies/Orgs.How many representatives should we bring: The maximum number of reps allowed from each company is 4 for the physical portion and 6 for the virtual.
Companies/Orgs.Can we access students' resumes in advan: Yes! We will collect resumes to share before the fair - please indicate your interest in this when/after registering
Companies/Orgs.Are there other ways we can connect with: Yes! This year we are looking to do smaller-scale events with individual companies at a time to help promote your brand and raise student awareness of the current and future opportunities you offer. This could be focused on going over the application process and providing tips for it, an in-depth exploration of different roles available, or even a technical workshop to teach students a valuable skill. If this new event style is of interest, please let us know!

Students.Is there any cost for students?: No, this is free for students to attend!
Students.Who can attend?: You don’t need to be studying Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Computer Science to attend. While these fields are the target audience, any undergraduate students looking for a software or hardware tech internship (or potentially new grad position) are welcome to attend. We highly encourage first year students interested in tech to also attend!!
Students.What should I wear / How formal is this?: We recommend business casual, aim for something you would wear at a tech interview
Students.How to start a conversation? / What to a: Asking about the application and interview process or what makes that company different. Also, please research the list of companies that will be attending (will be updated periodically). That way you can think of specific questions and demonstrate that you took the time to learn more about them.
Students.Should I bring a physical copy of my res: Most companies prefer students apply online to the job postings that they are interested in and will not accept physical resumes
Students.Had a great career fair experience, what: Ask if you can connect with the recruiter/company rep on LinkedIn with a personal message. Visit the company website and analyze their job opportunities.
Students.What time should we be there?: The event will be held  12pm to 5pm in-person on 8th floor DICE. A detailed schedule will be shared closer to the event.
